text:
sam: FYI — Cloud just sent a notice: starting next quarter eu-north region GPU committed pricing will increase for certain SKUs. No immediate network impact but unit compute cost changes. Need quick impact triage.

maya: Ugh. Do we have the exact SKUs and percent? Can you paste the notice? :eyes:

sam: pasted the excerpt in #incidents, but TL;DR: H100-equivalent reserved price +18-24% (depends on term), spot/ondemand more chaotic. Provider says supply-constrained.

luke: Do we know how much traffic we serve out of eu-north vs eu-west for hosted? I can check routing table but last month eu-north ~12% of tokens.

ana_finance: Quick numbers I ran: average hosted unit-margin across regions today ~42%. If eu-north cost rises 22% and we absorb it, margin on eu-north drops ~6.5 percentage points -> overall margin down ~0.8 p.p. across business (given 12% weight).

sam: That matches my back-of-envelope. But larger risk is Dedicated and Private customers with reserved capacity in that region — committed contract math is sticky. If our committed cost goes up we either eat margin or reprice/rescope.

infra-bot: [cost-alert] region eu-north GPU-price-change detected (provider-notice-id: PN-8912). Logged ticket INF-2026-317.

maya: For packaging implications: do we need to change how we sell Reserved capacity in eu-north? Maybe introduce a regional surcharge or change price banding by region? Both are friction.

luke: Another lever: routing policy. We can proactively route new hosted sessions to eu-west where possible to reduce eu-north utilization. But that increases cross-region egress for some customers and may add latency for EU-N users. Tradeoffs.

ana_finance: Quick proposal options (priority ordered):
1) Short-term: apply a temporary regional surcharge on new hosted requests in eu-north (visible on billing) + credits for existing committed customers (protect renewals).
2) Mid-term: update Dedicated SKUs — new regional price for future commits; grandfather existing contracts for N months.
3) Product-level: add "burst credits" for Dedicated that allow overflow into cheaper regions with auto-fallback.

sam: Love the options. For (1) we need legal + sales signoff. For (3) need infra feasibility — Luke, how hard is cross-region KV cache fallback and consistent routing?

luke: It's doable but not trivial. Problems: KV cache miss rate will spike after routing change; latencies for long-context chats will increase because of cold KV fetches. We could mitigate with prefix caching and sticky sessions for in-progress conversations. Rough ETA: 3-4 sprints for a robust rollout, 2 weeks for a quick toggle that just routes new sessions to eu-west and keeps old ones sticky.

maya: Can we get an immediate impact delta for unit economics per model family? I care about high-cost gen models vs cheap embed-only workloads.

ana_finance: I ran a mini-sensitivity by model class (very rough):
- large-gen (long-context, H100 heavy): per-token cost delta -> +0.00013 USD, margin hit ~9 p.p.
- medium-gen (A100-ish footprints): delta -> +0.00006 USD, margin hit ~4 p.p.
- embeddings/rerank (CPU or smaller GPU): negligible change (~+1 p.p.).

sam: So product packaging must avoid blanket pass-through to customers that mainly use embeddings. Consider a per-model bucket surcharge?

luke: We can expose a regional multiplier at the route level: route_config.region_multiplier = 1.22 for eu-north. That would let us apply to specific model families. Example snippet we could wire into routing config:
```
routes:
  - name: hosted-gen
    models: ["redwood-large-v1", "open-llama-70b"]
    region_multiplier: { eu-north: 1.22 }
```

maya: That looks reasonable. But UX: customers will complain if they see different per-token prices across regions. We should add a notice in billing and the console.

ana_finance: Also: impact on Dedicated renewals — if we change the price mid-contract, churn risk. Suggest white-glove outreach for customers with >$50k/month commitments in eu-north.

sam: Agreed. Action items:
- ana_finance: finalize the sensitivity table (by model family + by commitment tier) by EOD.
- luke: prototype a quick routing toggle and estimate cache/regression risk (1 day for toggle + 10 dev-hours for basic test).
- maya: draft customer messaging for hosted + Dedicated (point out supply-driven, temporary surcharge, mitigation options).
- sam: I'll loop in sales and legal and book a 30-min triage tomorrow.

ana_finance: I'll post the sensitivity table and a short spreadsheet then.

luke: I'll spin up a short test that routes a small % of traffic to eu-west and capture delta on P50 latency and cache hit rate.

maya: thanks. If anyone runs model-level marginals please ping me, we may need to adjust quota enforcement to avoid surprises for free-tier users. :pray:

sam: tagging @sales-leads and @legal for visibility. Let's keep the message concise in customer comms.

infra-bot: ticket INF-2026-317 updated: sensitivity-report-requested by ana_finance.

sam: OK closing thread for now — will reconvene after morning triage. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
